column3: With respect to the Commerce Office Park Mortgage Loan (5.9%), (i) the largest tenant, County of Los Angeles, Child Support Services Department, has the right to terminate its lease (A) with respect to its space at Building 5500, at any time after February 1, 2038 (12th anniversary of renewal term commencement) with 9 months prior notice and (B) with respect to its space at Building 5770, at any time after May 1, 2027 with 6 months prior notice; (ii) the second largest tenant, State of California, Department of Justice, has the right to terminate its lease at any time on or after August 31, 2029 with 60 days’ prior notice; (iii) the third largest tenant, County of Los Angeles, Sheriff Department, has the right to terminate its lease at any time after August 1, 2034 with 9 months prior notice, (iv) the fourth largest tenant, County of Los Angeles, Department of Health Services, has the right to terminate its lease at any time after April 30, 2025 with 6 months prior notice; and (v) the fifth largest tenant, State of CA, DMV, has the right to terminate its lease at any time on or after September 30, 2026 with 1 month notice.
